+type IsSegment interface{ isSegment() }

+	Keys            []string `yaml:"keys"`
+	SegmentOperator string   `yaml:"operator"`

+
+func (Segments) isSegment() {}
+
+type SegmentEmbed struct{ Value IsSegment }
+
+func (s *SegmentEmbed) KeysAndOperator() ([]string, string, error) {
+	switch v := s.Value.(type) {
+	case SegmentKey:
+		if v != "" {
+			return []string{string(v)}, "OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR", nil
+		}
+	case Segments:
+		if len(v.Keys) == 0 {
+			break
+		}
+		for _, key := range v.Keys {
+			if key == "" {
+				return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("segment key cannot be empty")
+			}
+		}
+		if len(v.Keys) == 1 {
+			return v.Keys, "OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR", nil
+		}
+		if v.SegmentOperator == "OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR" || v.SegmentOperator == "AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR" {
+			return v.Keys, v.SegmentOperator, nil
+		}
+	}
+	return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("segment must be a key or keys with a valid operator")
+}
+
+func (s SegmentEmbed) MarshalYAML() (interface{}, error) {
+	if _, _, err := s.KeysAndOperator(); err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	switch v := s.Value.(type) {
+	case SegmentKey:
+		return string(v), nil
+	case Segments:
+		return v, nil
+	}
+	return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid segment")
+}
+
+func (s *SegmentEmbed) UnmarshalYAML(unmarshal func(interface{}) error) error {
+	var raw interface{}
+	if err := unmarshal(&raw); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	switch v := raw.(type) {
+	case string:
+		s.Value = SegmentKey(v)
+	case map[interface{}]interface{}:
+		values := make(map[string]interface{}, len(v))
+		for key, value := range v {
+			name, ok := key.(string)
+			if !ok {
+				return fmt.Errorf("segment object keys must be strings")
+			}
+			values[name] = value
+		}
+		return s.unmarshalObject(values)
+	case map[string]interface{}:
+		return s.unmarshalObject(v)
+	default:
+		return fmt.Errorf("segment must be a string or object")
+	}
+	_, _, err := s.KeysAndOperator()
+	return err
+}
+
+func (s *SegmentEmbed) unmarshalObject(v map[string]interface{}) error {
+	if len(v) != 2 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("segment object requires keys and operator")
+	}
+	keysRaw, ok := v["keys"].([]interface{})
+	if !ok {
+		return fmt.Errorf("segment keys must be a list")
+	}
+	op, ok := v["operator"].(string)
+	if !ok {
+		return fmt.Errorf("segment operator must be a string")
+	}
+	keys := make([]string, 0, len(keysRaw))
+	for _, key := range keysRaw {
+		str, ok := key.(string)
+		if !ok {
+			return fmt.Errorf("segment keys must be strings")
+		}
+		keys = append(keys, str)
+	}
+	s.Value = Segments{Keys: keys, SegmentOperator: op}
+	_, _, err := s.KeysAndOperator()
+	return err
 }

@@ -0,0 +1,54 @@
+package ext
+
+import (
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"gopkg.in/yaml.v2"
+)
+
+func TestRuleSegmentFormats(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		input    string
+		keys     []string
+		operator string
+	}{
+		{"segment: foo", []string{"foo"}, "OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR"},
+		{"segment:\n  keys: [foo, bar]\n  operator: AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR", []string{"foo", "bar"}, "AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR"},
+		{"segment:\n  keys: [foo]\n  operator: AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR", []string{"foo"}, "OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR"},
+	} {
+		var r Rule
+		require.NoError(t, yaml.UnmarshalStrict([]byte(tc.input), &r))
+		keys, operator, err := r.Segment.KeysAndOperator()
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		require.Equal(t, tc.keys, keys)
+		require.Equal(t, tc.operator, operator)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestRuleSegmentRejectsMalformedValues(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, input := range []string{"segment: []", "segment: 42", "segment: ''", "segment: {keys: []}", "segment: {keys: [foo, bar]}", "segment: {keys: [foo, bar], operator: BAD}", "rank: 1"} {
+		var r Rule
+		err := yaml.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &r)
+		if err == nil {
+			_, _, err = r.Segment.KeysAndOperator()
+		}
+		require.Error(t, err, input)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestRuleSegmentMarshalBothFormats(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		segment SegmentEmbed
+		want    string
+	}{
+		{SegmentEmbed{Value: SegmentKey("foo")}, "segment: foo"},
+		{SegmentEmbed{Value: Segments{Keys: []string{"foo", "bar"}, SegmentOperator: "AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR"}}, "operator: AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR"},
+	} {
+		out, err := yaml.Marshal(&Rule{Segment: tc.segment})
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		require.Contains(t, string(out), tc.want)
+		require.True(t, strings.Contains(string(out), "segment:"))
+	}
+}

+
+func (s *SegmentEmbed) KeysAndOperator() ([]string, string, error) {
+	switch v := s.Value.(type) {
+	case SegmentKey:
+		if v != "" {
+			return []string{string(v)}, "OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR", nil
+		}
+	case Segments:
+		if len(v.Keys) == 0 {
+			break
+		}
+		for _, key := range v.Keys {
+			if key == "" {
+				return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("segment key cannot be empty")
+			}
+		}
+		if len(v.Keys) == 1 {
+			return v.Keys, "OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR", nil
+		}
+		if v.SegmentOperator == "OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR" || v.SegmentOperator == "AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR" {
+			return v.Keys, v.SegmentOperator, nil
+		}
+	}
+	return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("segment must be a key or keys with a valid operator")
+}
+
+func (s SegmentEmbed) MarshalYAML() (interface{}, error) {
+	if _, _, err := s.KeysAndOperator(); err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	switch v := s.Value.(type) {
+	case SegmentKey:
+		return string(v), nil
+	case Segments:
+		return v, nil
+	}
+	return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid segment")
+}
+
+func (s *SegmentEmbed) UnmarshalYAML(unmarshal func(interface{}) error) error {
+	var raw interface{}
+	if err := unmarshal(&raw); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	switch v := raw.(type) {
+	case string:
+		s.Value = SegmentKey(v)
+	case map[interface{}]interface{}:
+		values := make(map[string]interface{}, len(v))
+		for key, value := range v {
+			name, ok := key.(string)
+			if !ok {
+				return fmt.Errorf("segment object keys must be strings")
+			}
+			values[name] = value
+		}
+		return s.unmarshalObject(values)
+	case map[string]interface{}:
+		return s.unmarshalObject(v)
+	default:
+		return fmt.Errorf("segment must be a string or object")
+	}
+	_, _, err := s.KeysAndOperator()
+	return err
+}
+
+func (s *SegmentEmbed) unmarshalObject(v map[string]interface{}) error {
+	if len(v) != 2 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("segment object requires keys and operator")
+	}
+	keysRaw, ok := v["keys"].([]interface{})
+	if !ok {
+		return fmt.Errorf("segment keys must be a list")
+	}
+	op, ok := v["operator"].(string)
+	if !ok {
+		return fmt.Errorf("segment operator must be a string")
+	}
+	keys := make([]string, 0, len(keysRaw))
+	for _, key := range keysRaw {
+		str, ok := key.(string)
+		if !ok {
+			return fmt.Errorf("segment keys must be strings")
+		}
+		keys = append(keys, str)
+	}
+	s.Value = Segments{Keys: keys, SegmentOperator: op}
+	_, _, err := s.KeysAndOperator()
+	return err
 }

@@ -0,0 +1,54 @@
+package ext
+
+import (
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"gopkg.in/yaml.v2"
+)
+
+func TestRuleSegmentFormats(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		input    string
+		keys     []string
+		operator string
+	}{
+		{"segment: foo", []string{"foo"}, "OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR"},
+		{"segment:\n  keys: [foo, bar]\n  operator: AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR", []string{"foo", "bar"}, "AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR"},
+		{"segment:\n  keys: [foo]\n  operator: AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR", []string{"foo"}, "OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR"},
+	} {
+		var r Rule
+		require.NoError(t, yaml.UnmarshalStrict([]byte(tc.input), &r))
+		keys, operator, err := r.Segment.KeysAndOperator()
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		require.Equal(t, tc.keys, keys)
+		require.Equal(t, tc.operator, operator)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestRuleSegmentRejectsMalformedValues(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, input := range []string{"segment: []", "segment: 42", "segment: ''", "segment: {keys: []}", "segment: {keys: [foo, bar]}", "segment: {keys: [foo, bar], operator: BAD}", "rank: 1"} {
+		var r Rule
+		err := yaml.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &r)
+		if err == nil {
+			_, _, err = r.Segment.KeysAndOperator()
+		}
+		require.Error(t, err, input)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestRuleSegmentMarshalBothFormats(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		segment SegmentEmbed
+		want    string
+	}{
+		{SegmentEmbed{Value: SegmentKey("foo")}, "segment: foo"},
+		{SegmentEmbed{Value: Segments{Keys: []string{"foo", "bar"}, SegmentOperator: "AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR"}}, "operator: AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR"},
+	} {
+		out, err := yaml.Marshal(&Rule{Segment: tc.segment})
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		require.Contains(t, string(out), tc.want)
+		require.True(t, strings.Contains(string(out), "segment:"))
+	}
+}
